name: readiness
title: Agent-ready documentation check
outcome: A prioritized assessment of whether agents can reliably use the repository as input.

steps.title: Assess repository readiness
steps.prompt: Analyze the repository as input to future documentation work. Answer the declared source-readiness questions using supplied governed search evidence when configured; never infer missing host evidence. Return its documentation state, discoverable sources and validation, information gaps, prioritized recommendations, and confidence with file evidence. Do not broaden this into public release-documentation readiness, do not claim absence beyond a validated bounded-search disposition, and do not modify files.
